subject.title: fix(canvas): restore shipped policy/host-disable contracts; harden workspaces doctor cleanup

question: Should this protected PR proceed only after a redacted real gateway/doctor proof covers the restored host-disable contract and workspace-overlap non-deletion path, or should an authorized maintainer explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The patch changes compatibility-sensitive configuration behavior and destructive cleanup safeguards; tests and check results in the PR body do not by themselves demonstrate the after-fix runtime behavior required for this external PR.

options.title: Request real behavior proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or live-run transcript showing both Canvas disable switches suppress routes, capabilities, and core tools, plus doctor reporting and skipping a colliding workspace path.

options.title: Authorize a proof override
options.body: An authorized maintainer may explicitly accept the existing automated evidence if they determine equivalent runtime proof is unnecessary for this repair.

recommendation.title: Request real behavior proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or live-run transcript showing both Canvas disable switches suppress routes, capabilities, and core tools, plus doctor reporting and skipping a colliding workspace path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Canvas and Workspaces changes that this compatibility follow-up repairs.
